QuestInfo.name: Saving the Townspeople 1
QuestInfo.0: There's trouble with townspeople who got attacked by the kobolds. Hurry over to Woodrock.
QuestInfo.1: Woodrock said #b#p9390451##k went into the dark forest, but he can't go in because of the kobolds. Go into #b#m866000105##k to save #b#p9390451##k.

0.0: There you are! I need your help! Some townspeople ventured into the forest and didn't return, so I followed them...
0.1: And I saw a whole mess of kobolds!
0.2: Can you find Tom's grandma in the dark forest? I don't know if this'll help, but she's one hot mama...

yes.0: Thank you! I should've listened to you earlier...

no.0: I guess I deserve that since I didn't believe you earlier, but this isn't about me!

yes.0: I was just here, eating raspberries...

npc.0: Did you find Tom's grandma? Where could she be?! I hope she's safe!
